ability.name: climb_surfaces
ability.effect: Can walk on sheer cliffs and upside down.

behavior_rules.rule: May spring on prey from above.

ability.name: camouflage
ability.effect: Characters encountering it suffer a -3 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: sticky_tongue
ability.effect: Can lash its tongue to 5'. On a hit, the victim is yanked to the mouth and automatically bitten for 2d4 damage without another attack throw.

ability.name: tail_lash
ability.effect: On a successful tail lash, the opponent is knocked down and may not attack that round.

ability.name: infravision
ability.effect: Has infravision to 90' when it lowers its special membrane-like eyelids.

Eggs do not fight.

Village witch doctor is statistically a champion with Mage abilities of level 1d4.

terrain.primary: Marshes and banks of bodies of water.

attack_routine.name: weapon_attack
attack_routine.notes: Common weapons include spiked clubs, javelins, and barbed darts; barbed darts are treated as daggers when thrown.

ability.name: leader_stat_blocks
ability.notes: Champion: AC 5, HD 3+1, hp 17, natural attacks +1 damage, weapons +2 damage. Sub-chieftain: AC 6, HD 4+1, hp 21, natural attacks +2 damage, weapons +3 damage. Chieftain: AC 7, HD 6+2, hp 30, natural attacks +2 damage, weapons +3 damage.

attack_effect.trigger: Occurs when panicked locusts flee into creatures.

attack_effect.to_hit_rule: Attack throw is always resolved against AC 0 because the effect occurs whether or not armor is bypassed.
attack_effect.follow_up: After 1 turn the target becomes immune to the odor. Until the spittle is rinsed off, any creature coming within 5' of the target must save versus Poison or be wracked with vomiting.

mobility_rules.rule: When disturbed, locusts typically jump up to 60' away.

ability.name: shriek
ability.effect: All locusts in a group shriek when disturbed, attracting wandering monsters.

ability.name: panic_flight
ability.effect: Panicked flight is in a random direction; it moves toward the group half the time.

procedure.name: wandering_monster_attraction
procedure.condition: One or more cavern locusts are attacking.

steps.step: Roll an encounter throw each round.
If wandering monsters are indicated, they arrive in 1d4 rounds.

immunities.immunity: All attacks from normal weapons while in animal form.

ability.name: shapechange
ability.effect: Can take the form of one kind of animal. When killed, reverts to human form.

ability.name: summon_kindred_animal
ability.effect: Can summon 1d2 animals of its type; they appear in 1d4 rounds.

ability.name: wolfsbane_ward
ability.effect: If touched by wolfsbane, must save versus Poison or flee in fear.

ability.name: animal_form_communication
ability.effect: In animal form, may communicate only with animals of its type and may not speak humanoid languages.

ability.name: lycanthropy_disease
ability.effect: Transmitted when a creature loses 50% or more of its total hit points to the lycanthrope's claws and bite.
ability.notes: Victim becomes the attacker's lycanthrope type in 2d6 days, with secondary characteristics appearing several days before full transformation. Only humans transform; demi-humans and other humanoids die after 2d6 days instead. Cure disease cures acquired lycanthropy only if cast before the disease fully takes hold. Inherited lycanthropy cannot be cured.

ability.name: inherited_lycanthropy
ability.effect: If one parent is a lycanthrope, child has a 50% chance to become a lycanthrope at puberty. If both parents are lycanthropes, chance is 100%.
ability.notes: If parents are different lycanthrope types, determine the child's type randomly between the parental types.

ability.name: animal_sense
ability.effect: Horses and other domestic animals sense nearby lycanthropes and act restless or bolt.

50% of gangs wear chainmail and shields, carry long swords, and ride light warhorses.

1 11th level fighter if fleet has 200 or more pirates
1 8th level fighter with a pirate king

population_rules.rule: 70% are chaotic buccaneers that attack any ship.
30% are neutral privateers that attack only enemy national shipping.
The number of pirates encountered equals the full required crew of the ships in the fleet, including sailors, marines, and rowers.

combat_rules.rule: All pirates wear leather armor and carry swords.
40% also carry crossbows or short bows.
Marines and sailors are always pirates. Riverboat and longship rowers are pirates. Galley rowers are captive slaves.
Slaves are unarmed and do not fight.

ability.effect: When pirates are encountered away from their lair, the captain or king has a treasure map to the lair.

treasure_rules.rule: Printed treasure type is not restricted to lairs.

population_rules.rule: Caravans consist of 10-40 large wagons.
Each wagon is drawn by 4 heavy draft horses.
For every 10 wagons there are 5 merchants on medium riding horses.
For every 10 wagons there are 20 1st level fighter guards led by 2 3rd level fighters on medium riding horses.
Each caravan has 1 guard captain, a 5th level fighter on a medium warhorse.

combat_rules.rule: Merchants wear chainmail and carry crossbows and daggers.
Guards wear chainmail and carry swords, crossbows, and daggers.
The guard captain wears plate armor and carries sword, crossbow, and dagger.
Riding and draft animal types may vary by terrain.

social_structure.rule: Enemies of neanderthals, dwarves, and gnomes; sometimes joins orcs and goblins.

ability.name: pack_capacity
ability.effect: Carries 20 stone comfortably and a maximum of 40 stone.
ability.limitation: At 40 stone, movement is reduced to 60' per turn.

ability.name: ornery
ability.effect: May attack if particularly provoked.

procedure.name: dungeon_pack_use
procedure.condition: Judge permits and dungeon conditions allow.
procedure.outcome: A mule may be taken into the dungeon to transport equipment or treasure.

immunities.immunity: All attacks except magical weapons, spells, and fire-based attacks.

resistances.resistance: Takes only half damage from magical weapons, spells, and fire-based attacks.

ability.name: paralyzing_dread
ability.effect: Any being seeing a mummy must save versus Paralysis or become paralyzed with dread.
ability.termination: Effect ends if the mummy leaves the victim's range of vision or engages in combat.

ability.name: mummy_rot
ability.effect: Mummy rot is a curse, not a natural disease.
ability.notes: Targets cannot benefit from magical healing and heal naturally at only 1/10 the normal rate. Remove curse removes mummy rot.

combat_rules.rule: Typically uses spears and weapons with stone blades.

social_structure.rule: Despises kobolds, goblins, and morlocks, and enjoys the company of gnomes and dwarves.

population_rules.rule: Up to 6 dryads may rarely be encountered together.

ability.name: tree_bond
ability.effect: Bound to a particular tree.
ability.termination: If the tree is killed, the dryad dies.

ability.name: tree_merge
ability.effect: May physically join with its tree and disappear.

ability.name: range_limit
ability.effect: May not move more than 240' from its tree.
ability.termination: If farther away, dies after 1 turn.

ability.name: charm
ability.effect: A target that fails a saving throw versus Spells goes to the dryad's tree and disappears within it.
ability.notes: Any individual who does this is lost forever.

treasure_rules.rule: Treasure from past victims or infatuations is often stored at the base of the tree under the roots.

ability.name: charm
ability.effect: A target that fails a saving throw versus Spells is taken into the naiad's watery domain and serves for 12 months.

ability.name: water_breathing
ability.effect: Can cast water breathing at will on a character.

ability.name: summon_giant_bass
ability.effect: May summon a giant bass for protection.
ability.notes: Giant bass: AL N, MV 120' (40'), AC 2, HD 2, #AT 1, Dmg 1d6, Save F1, ML 0.

attack_effect.effect: Eats through cloth, wood, and leather after 1 round, but cannot affect stone or metal.

mobility_rules.rule: Has no fixed form and can squeeze under doors and into small spaces.

resistances.resistance: Fire and cold affect it normally.

ability.name: division
ability.effect: Divides into 1d3+2 smaller amoebas with 2 Hit Dice each.
ability.notes: Smaller jellies deal 1d6 damage to flesh and are not further affected by lightning or weapons.

attack_effect.effect: Each tentacle that hits constricts and deals 1d3 damage each successive round.
attack_effect.follow_up: Each constricting tentacle imposes a cumulative -1 penalty to the victim's attack throws.

mobility_rules.rule: When fleeing, moves at triple speed: 270' per round.

ability.name: sever_tentacle
ability.effect: A tentacle can be cut off by a single blow dealing 6 or more points of damage.

ability.name: ink_cloud
ability.effect: Sprays a 40' radius cloud of black ink to obscure its retreat.
